model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss values for five different models—Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)—as they train over a number of iterations. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, labeled “#Iteration,” and spans from 0 to 140,000 on a linear scale without explicit unit notation. The y-axis represents the loss, labeled “Loss,” and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 on a linear scale. The “Vanilla” model is shown with a purple line and circular markers, starting at a loss of approximately 3.4 and decreasing sharply to around 2.45 by 140,000 iterations. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” model is depicted with a blue line and circular markers, beginning at a loss of approximately 3.3 and declining to about 2.65. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” model is shown with a green line and circular markers, starting at approximately 3.3 and falling to roughly 2.55. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” model is represented by an orange line and circular markers, beginning at approximately 3.3 and decreasing to about 2.5. The “SepLLM (n=128)” model is shown with a red line and circular markers, starting at approximately 3.3 and reducing to around 2.5. All lines exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss followed by a gradual flattening toward the end of the iteration range.
